interface.longDescription: Skills-first Minecraft Bedrock engineering with bounded preflight planning, Domain-Based Hybrid coordination, project continuity, version compatibility research, BP/RP authoring, UI, entities, animation, geometry, textures, UV workflows, audits and validation. Skills and bounded local utilities only; no MCP connection or remote execution backend with fast staged file analysis, dependency-aware scanning and incremental verification; high-confidence junk-file filtering with full inventory and safe re-inclusion. Adaptive process control: detects repeated failures, stale evidence, no-progress loops and avoidable rework; replans with bounded recovery while preserving verified results. Outcome quality assessment: evaluates completeness, correctness, cross-system consistency, reliability, maintainability, evidence and delivery readiness against original acceptance criteria.
defaultPrompt: Create a Minecraft Bedrock add-on from scratch or extend my existing project. Work from files I provide or an actually connected workspace, preserve existing mechanics and assets, and produce complete BP/RP files with validation evidence.

Audit this Bedrock add-on or candidate release. Check archive integrity, BP/RP manifests and dependency links, JSON/JavaScript, resource references, identifiers, and regressions. Provide exact paths, evidence and severity; do not delete resources.

Research this Minecraft Bedrock feature for the exact target version. Prioritize official Creator documentation and matching Mojang samples, verify API and format compatibility, compare implementations, cite sources, and implement only when requested.
Create or audit an RP animation clip with bone channels and keyframes, bind its alias to the client entity, and connect it to an animation-controller state without replacing existing resources.

Audit an entity animation pipeline end to end: verify client-entity aliases, animation clips, controller states and transitions, geometry identifiers, animated bone names, and direct playback references. Report exact files and confidence.

Audit Bedrock geometry UVs before texture work: inspect classic box and per-face UV mappings, check texture canvas and the explicitly linked PNG, report exact geometry/bone/cube/face findings, and distinguish static checks from Minecraft rendering tests.
Generate a labeled UV template from this Bedrock geometry, show UV overlaps and out-of-bounds regions, then prepare a texture workflow without modifying source geometry or existing texture.

Paint an entity texture from its actual Bedrock geometry UVs: select bone/cube/face regions, apply explicit pixel operations, preserve source pixels and alpha, then validate the resulting PNG and UV bounds.

Transfer a reviewed reference PNG onto exact geometry UV regions: map explicit source rectangles to bone/cube/face selectors, choose nearest or bilinear sampling, preserve a base texture and alpha, and report UV overlap/runtime limitations.

Prepare a UV mapping plan for this Bedrock geometry and reference sheet: enumerate each cube face, validate source crops, expand explicit selectors, report unmapped faces and UV overlaps, and provide an actionable transfer plan.

Review visual reference regions against a Bedrock entity geometry: bind the exact reference PNG hash, assign explicit semantic labels and exact bone/cube/face targets, reject uncertain matches, inspect coverage and UV overlaps.

Retarget a reference image onto this Bedrock entity texture in one guarded workflow. Use explicit, visually reviewed source crops and exact bone/cube/face selectors, require approval, validate UV coverage/overlaps, then verify output PNG dimensions and SHA-256.
